description: The line plot illustrates evaluation perplexity (PPL) as a function of the activated parameters ratio, measured in percentage. The x-axis, labeled 'Activated Parameters Ratio (%)', spans from 25 to 100 in reverse order, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 25. The y-axis, labeled 'Eval PPL', uses a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.5. The red dashed line, labeled 'Transformer', remains horizontal across the entire x-axis at a constant PPL value of approximately 11.6. The gray line with square markers, labeled 'Only MoHD FFN', begins at a PPL of about 11.5 at 100% activation, decreases slightly to a PPL of 11.2 at 50% activation, then rises to approximately 11.8 at 25% activation. The purple line with circle markers, labeled 'Only MoHD ATTN', starts at a PPL of about 11.5 at 100% activation and increases sharply to reach a PPL of approximately 14.0 at 25% activation. The blue line with cross markers, labeled 'MoHD ATTN + MLP', begins at a PPL of 11.5 at 100% activation and follows an upward trend, reaching a PPL of approximately 13.8 at 25% activation. A legend is positioned in the top left corner of the plot to identify each method.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (PPL) across varying ratios of activated parameters measured in percentage. The x-axis is labeled as 'Activated Parameters Ratio (%)' and ranges from 25 to 100 in reverse order, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled 'Eval PPL' with a linear scale from 11.5 to 14.0 and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The red dashed line labeled 'Transformer' remains horizontal across the x-axis at a PPL of approximately 11.6. The gray line with square markers for 'Only MoHD FFN' starts at a PPL of about 11.5 at 100% activation, decreases slightly to a PPL of 11.2 at 50%, then rises again to approximately 11.8 at 25%. The purple line with circle markers for 'Only MoHD ATTN' starts at about 11.5, rises significantly to around 14.0 at 25%. The blue line with cross markers for 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' begins at 11.5 and follows an upward trend to approximately 13.8 at 25%. A legend is placed at the top left corner of the plot, indicating the methods compared.
